spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
  avg(out_temperature_c) AS "Temperature"
FROM simulation_telemetry
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
  avg(sys_cop_heating) AS "Heating COP"
FROM simulation_telemetry
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
  avg(sys_cop_cooling) AS "Cooling COP"
FROM simulation_telemetry
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
  key AS metric,
  avg(value::numeric) AS value
FROM simulation_telemetry, jsonb_each_text(room_temperatures_c)
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND split_part(key, ':', 1) IN ($building)
  AND split_part(key, ':', 2) IN ($apartment)
  AND split_part(key, ':', 3) IN ($room)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),

FROM simulation_telemetry, jsonb_each_text(room_co2_ppm)
WHERE

  AND split_part(key, ':', 2) IN ($apartment)

GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT

SELECT

ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
  avg(sys_electricity_price) AS "Electricity price"
FROM simulation_telemetry

  $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),

spec.name: building

spec.query:
SELECT DISTINCT split_part(key, ':', 1) AS building
FROM (
  SELECT jsonb_object_keys(room_temperatures_c) AS key
  FROM simulation_telemetry
  ORDER BY time DESC
) AS rooms
ORDER BY building ASC;
